title: External MT Results Index (bulk, machine-derived)
description: Compact index of publicly reported MT benchmark scores: best published score per (language pair, public test set, metric), extracted commit-pinned from the Helsinki-NLP leaderboards (OPUS-MT-leaderboard + External-MT-leaderboard, CC-BY-SA-4.0). RELATIVE-ONLY lane — every test set indexed here is public; values must never be cited as absolute quality claims nor ranked against held-out-lane results. The curated, hand-verified headline tier is external-results.json; this is its exhaustive machine sibling. Regenerated by arena/scripts/import_mt_leaderboards.py; tracked in the monorepo, NOT bundled into the npm package.

provider.description: Collective id for the indexed score sources (e.g. 'mt-leaderboards').

commit.description: Upstream commit SHA the score DBs were fetched at — the whole index is reproducible from these pins.

credit.description: Human credit for the upstream project (always-cite-work principle).

model_id_prefixes.description: Model-id prefixes contributed by this source — maps any cell back to its leaderboard.

provenance.description: Must carry champollion-derived naming the upstreams: the best-per-pair SELECTION is ours; the values are upstream's published scores verbatim.

family_derivation.description: Model-id prefix -> provider family (longest prefix wins). Lets consumers roll up 'who wins this pair' without their own string heuristics.

contamination_posture.description: testset id -> posture note. Every testset key used in pairs MUST appear here (cross-checked by cli/test/external-mt-index.test.js).

models.description: Deduplicated model-id string table; pairs reference models by index.

pairs.description: langpair ('src-tgt', ISO 639-3 with optional script suffix) -> testset id -> metric id -> [modelIndex, value].
